Package org.geysermc.paletter.block

Class RegisteredBlock

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.block.RegisteredBlock
public final class RegisteredBlock extends Object
A block (type level) inside one palette: its state properties, components and origin, and its states, which carry the runtime ids.

In BlockNetworkIds.HASHED palettes, vanilla states are shared between the palettes of all versions, while the state set of a block can differ between versions, so a state does not know its block: BlockRegistry.block(String) and BlockRegistry.block(RegisteredBlockState) give the block of the palette you ask.

Since:
1.0.0

      Since:

    • components

      public @NonNull List<BlockComponent> components(@NonNull RegisteredBlockState state)
      Returns:
      the components in effect for a state of this block: those of the block, plus those of the permutations of its CustomBlock whose condition matches the state, replacing components of the same name. Empty for vanilla blocks

    • properties

      public @NonNull Properties properties(@NonNull RegisteredBlockState state)
      Returns:
      the properties in effect for a state of this block: those of the block, with the components of the permutations that apply to the state set on top

    • propertyData

      public @Nullable org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap propertyData()
      Returns:
      the block property data sent for this block in this palette (data driven vanilla blocks and custom blocks), else null. A palette patched with more custom blocks has a RegisteredBlock of its own for every custom block, because the numeric block ids inside the data change when blocks are added
